title: Vanni Soft Blue Tea Deck
brands: Vanni Pilates: Soft Blue. Kraft pouch, cream label, periwinkle blue wash, co-branded with the partner name only (no partner logo).
WellNest Teas: Three Projects, Project 2: Three Collab Teas; R107 refresh (Max via WellNest, Oct 17 2026 20:04 ICT), built on the mockups (Max 20:09 ICT).
format_note: Every pick: A = Our Pick (draft, confirm), B = a sensible swap from the source. From Your Swipes items are settled and not asked.
flags_unconfirmed: A 'beauty' name may need the same Thai FDA check as Beauty.
